description: Austin Water publishes counts of wastewater service connections by customer class and postal code. The metadata identifies three columns: service connections, customer class and postal code. These counts describe the distribution of connected customers and can supply a spatial demand-allocation input for wastewater-system simulation. They do not provide pipe connectivity, connection coordinates, flow rates or per-customer wastewater generation. The inspected metadata does not establish a reference date for the counts or whether inactive connections are included. The provider reports an October 2025 data-update timestamp, which does not itself establish the observation period. Aggregation by postal code also limits inference about individual properties or network catchments. The public portal and JSON catalogue metadata are free to access. The licence is Public Domain. Legacy CSV export checks returned HTTP 410; current distribution access remains unverified. No dataset rows were downloaded. Related records include the parent open-data catalogue for Austin.
